description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2530007530709 GOVERNOR ASSEMBLY,A: Line 0001 Qty 34 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0098 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
